messages:
taylor: Heads-up: billing alerts fired for proj-inventory but the calls were actually proxied through a shared SA. Dashboard shows SA owner project which tripped budget alarms for the wrong team.
robin: Can you paste a minimal request example?
taylor: Repro: `POST /v1/chat` with `Authorization: Bearer exch-7a9`, `X-Delegated-Project: proj-inventory`, `X-Request-ID: r-882` — usage table shows owner-project-ops.
hyun: Router today resolves billing to token principal for SA-derived tokens. Exchange tokens include orig_project claim now, but router doesn’t consult it.
emily: This will create a bad UX for teams using delegated workflows. Also billing pipelines downstream expect the displayed project to align with chargeable project.
robin: Proposal: implement an attribution resolver that prefers (a) verified exchange claim, (b) validated origin header, (c) token owner. Keep behavior behind FF and per-org toggle.
hyun: For rollout we need: telemetry + alert suppression hook (so alerts don’t misfire while we collect data), audit logs for each resolution decision, and a migration note for billing ETL to optionally ingest `resolved_attribution`.
taylor: Telemetry metrics to emit: `auth.attribution.decision` (exchange|header|token), `auth.attribution.mismatch` (bool), `auth.exchange.token_seen` (count). Tag by org and route.
emily: I can add an alerting filter that ignores attribution mismatches for existing alerts until FF is turned on org-by-org.
robin: UX ask: in the console show both columns "Requested project" and "Billing project" with an inline help pill describing precedence and a link to opt-in settings.
hyun: Dev plan: (1) small PR to emit the new metrics and add structured audit log behind FF, (2) implement resolution logic in router behind FF, (3) expose org toggle + console columns.	taylor: Also add unit/integration tests covering exchange tokens with tampered claims to ensure we only trust exchange when proof_verified=true.
emily: I'll coordinate with CS to reach out to teams who saw alerts. We should offer to map their budgets if we flip attribution later.
infra-bot: Created INFRA-3120: attribution resolver + telemetry + org opt-in toggle (30d audit retention).
robin: Timeline suggestion: 10 days telemetry, 3 org opt-ins as guinea pigs, 1% traffic canary, then scale to 10% opt-in. Post-30d review before recommending default change.
taylor: Sounds good. Please include a migration sample payload for billing: `resolved_attribution: project=proj-inventory,source=exchange,verified=true` so billing ETL can switch safely.
hyun: Will do. I'll also add a feature flag that toggles the audit payload verbosity so we don't overwhelm logs.
emily: I'll draft the console microcopy and notify account leads.
robin: OK moving to action items. hyun please link PRs here when ready.
hyun: Will open PRs today for telemetry + audit logs.
infra-bot: Reminder: schedule a postmortem review if any billing anomalies occur during rollout.
